bari kharabi hai naap tol mein kami kernay walon ki
jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab woh logon  say khud koi cheez naap kerletay hain to poori poori letay hain ,
aur jab woh kissi ko naap ker ya tol ker-detay hain to ghata ker-detay hain .
kiya yeh log yeh nahi sochtay kay enhen aik zabardast din mai zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?
Aik baray zabardast din main
jiss din sabb log Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay samney kharray hon gay .
hergiz aisa nahi chahiye ! yaqeen jano kay bad-kaar logon  ka aemal nama sijjeen mein hai
aur tumhen kiya maloom kay sijjeen ( mein rakha huwa aemal nama ) kiya cheez hai-?
woh aik likhi hoi kitab hai .
uss din bari kharabi hogi haq ko jhutlaney walon ki ,
jo jaza o saza kay din ko jhutlatay hain .
aur uss din ko wohi jhutlata hai jo hadd say guzra huwa gunehgaar ho ,
ussay jab humari aayaten parh ker sunai jati hon to woh kehta ho kay :  yeh to pichlay logon  kay afsaney hain .
hergiz nahi ! balkay jo amal yeh kertay rahey hain , uss ney inn kay dilon per zang charha diya hai .
hergiz nahi ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log uss din apney perwerdigar kay deedar say mehroom hon gay .
phir inn ko dozakh mein dakhil hona parray ga .
phir kaha jaye ga kay :  yeh hai woh cheez jiss ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay !
khabrdar ! naik logon  ka aemal nama illeeyeen mein hai .
aur tumhen kiya maloom kay illeeyeen ( mein rakha huwa aemal nama ) kiya cheez hai-?
woh aik likhi hoi kitab hai
jissay muqarrab farishtay dekhtay hain
yaqeen jano kay naik log bari naimaton mein hon gay .
aaram deh nishiston per bethay nazara ker rahey hon gay .
unn kay chehron per naimaton mein rehney say jo ronaq aaye gi , tum ussay saaf pehchan lo gay .
unhen aesi khalis sharab pilai jaye gi jiss per mohar lagi hogi ,
uss ki mohar bhi mushk hi mushk hogi . aur yehi woh cheez hai jiss per lalchaney walon ko barh charh ker lalchana chahiye .
aur uss sharab mein tasneem ka paani mila huwa hoga ,
jo aik aisa chashma hai kay jiss say Allah kay muqarrab banday paani piyen gay .
jo log mujrim thay , woh emaan walon per hansa kertay thay .
aur jab unn kay paas say guzartay thay to aik doosray ko aankhon hi aankhon mein isharay kertay thay .
aur jab apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker jatay thay , to dil lagi kertay huye jatay thay .
aur jab inn ( mominon ) ko dekhtay to kehtay kay yeh log yaqeenan gumrah hain ,
halankay unn ko inn musalmanon per nigran bana ker nahi bheja gaya tha .
aakhir hoga yeh kay aaj emaan laney walay kafiron per hans rahey hon gay ,
aaram deh nishiston per bethay huye dekh rahey hon gay
kay kafir logon  ko waqaee unn kamon ka badla mil gaya jo woh kiya kertay thay .
